messages:
ana (devex): support ticket: dev launched quickstart from Windows Start Menu on WSL2. redwoodctl says token saved but app still 401s. they insist they followed quickstart verbatim.
drew (eng-cli): same class of bug as we've seen, but any unique logs?
support-bot: user logs attached (sanitized): 
INFO auth: attempting write to /mnt/c/Users/dev/.config/redwood/profiles/ci.json
ERROR auth: write failed: permission denied
INFO cli: login succeeded (printed path)

mika (eng-runtime): two different failures possible: write failing, or correct write but app reading different profile (env vs disk). did they run `profile use`?
ana (devex): they did `profile use local-ci` after login. quickstart still pointed to hosted.
harry (devops): quick repro idea: Start Menu shortcut launches shim which sets HOME=/mnt/c/Users/dev; WSL shell has HOME=/home/dev. profile use writes to XDG under /mnt/c/... but local agent launched from WSL reads /home. mismatch.
drew (eng-cli): our current behavior swallows write errors and prints success. that's the root UX bug here. immediate fix: return non-zero if write/read-after-write verification fails. also print the canonical path (resolved) and whether the file exists & perms.
mika (eng-runtime): agree. additional guard: when running under WSL (detect /proc/version contains Microsoft) and HOME starts with /mnt/, warn loudly: "Detected Windows-hosted HOME while running under WSL context; this may not persist to your WSL distro. Run login from your distro shell or set XDG_CONFIG_HOME explicitly."
nana (devex): can we add a small helper for support: `redwoodctl doctor --check-paths` that prints both resolved XDG and legacy locations and notes which profile would be used by the current binary?
harry (devops): yes and also add a watch/signal to the local profile agent so `profile use` triggers an in-memory reload. right now agent caches env snapshot and spawns localtest with old RWCTL_PROFILE.
drew (eng-cli): for CI/headless flows, we should add `--write-profile` (atomic, 0600) and `--config-dir` flags. then `redwoodctl login --headless --write-profile --profile local-ci --config-dir /build/.redwood` would be the supported pattern.
mika (eng-runtime): plus telemetry for write failures so we can measure how many users hit this.
nana (devex): support reply i'll send: 1) Open your WSL distro shell. 2) Run `which -a redwoodctl` and ensure same binary. 3) `env HOME="$HOME" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config" redwoodctl login` 4) `redwoodctl profile use local-ci` then restart app. include link to GH issue.
support-bot: created GH#7899 "redwoodctl prints success when token write fails on foreign mount; add WSL detection, doctor cmd, and CI write flags"

drew (eng-cli): i'll PR the write-verify and --write-profile flag. mika, can you handle agent refresh and WSL heuristics?
mika (eng-runtime): on it. thanks. once PRs land i'll update quickstart and the MSI postinstall blurb about launching from Start Menu on WSL setups.
nana (devex): :white_check_mark: closing thread after PRs merge.
